Masked-Cell Validation (Genuine Holdout, Refits the Model)

Source: R/profile_validate_masked.R
profile_validate_heldout.Rd

Masks a reproducible, eligibility-preserving subset of genuinely observed cells, sets them to NA in a copy of Y, rebuilds the Stan design on the masked data via profile_build_design, refits via profile_fit_joint_bernoulli, and predicts the held-out cells from THAT refit (validation_mode = "refit_masked"). This is the preferred, more expensive procedure once computationally affordable; see profile_validate_masked for the cheaper in-sample diagnostic.

Usage

profile_validate_heldout(
  Y,
  X,
  ids,
  output_dir,
  fraction_to_mask = 0.05,
  max_mask_per_cell = NULL,
  min_tested_after_mask = 10L,
  min_resistant_after_mask = 3L,
  min_susceptible_after_mask = 3L,
  sampler_config = list(),
  n_draws = 500L,
  seed = 123L
)

Arguments

Y, ids

The SAME Y matrix and ids data frame passed to profile_build_design (via profile_prepare_model_data) – the observed side of every comparison comes from these, not re-derived from raw data.

X

The SAME covariate design matrix used for the original fit (nrow(X) == nrow(Y)) – rebuilt against the masked Y via profile_build_design.

output_dir

Character. Passed to profile_fit_joint_bernoulli for the refit's artifacts.

fraction_to_mask

Numeric in (0, 1]. Target fraction of observed cells to mask per group x class cell, before the eligibility floor and max_mask_per_cell cap. Default 0.05.

max_mask_per_cell

Integer or NULL. Optional additional cap.

min_tested_after_mask, min_resistant_after_mask, min_susceptible_after_mask

Integer. Panel-eligibility floors enforced during masking. Default 10L, 3L, 3L.

sampler_config

Named list. Passed to profile_fit_joint_bernoulli for the refit. Default list() (that function's own defaults).

n_draws

Integer. Posterior draws used (subsampled if the fit has more). Default 500L.

seed

Integer. Mask selection AND posterior-draw-subsampling seed. Default 123L.

Value

Named list: predictions, summary (same shape as profile_validate_masked, validation_mode = "refit_masked"), and refit_result (the full return value of profile_fit_joint_bernoulli on the masked data, so the refit's own sampler diagnostics can be checked via profile_check_sampler before trusting these scores).
